concerns.description: Recipe and batch identity, requested mode changes, interlock observations and immutable scan decisions
concerns.rationale: Typed contracts and one logical producer express discrete responsibility without prescribing the control implementation.

concerns.description: Periodic release and reaction deadline change acceptable system behavior
concerns.rationale: Activation admits a reaction but does not constrain clock, release jitter, sample age or completion time.

concerns.description: Explicit inhibited/startup behavior and nonautomatic recovery
concerns.rationale: Modes can be domain data; hazard-specific transition and recovery obligations need contracts beyond a graph.

concerns.description: A cyclic IEC 61131-3 task may realize ReactToScan. A distributed IEC 61499 network is an alternative realization only after event/data and scheduling semantics are specified; it is not equivalent merely because arrows match.
concerns.rationale: A thread, synchronous node or PLC task is a realization of the same responsibility; the mechanism alone does not discharge requirements.

concerns.description: PLC task periods, remote I/O bus budgets, sealer controller assignment and safety-controller separation are L2 deployment analysis inputs.
concerns.rationale: Physical mapping and latency budgets need deployment-specific evidence, separate from logical ownership.

concerns.description: IEC 61131 task execution and input/output-image semantics; IEC 61499 execution-control charts and event/data association; physical stopping-distance analysis
concerns.rationale: A matching typed interface cannot define the external tool model of computation, prove safety, or solve physical equations.

facets.meaning: Illustrative release-to-command requirement measured on one monotonic clock; period changes require domain review.
obligations: Offline inequality validation is not a WCET proof, schedulability analysis, timer implementation or runtime safety proof.
Specify release jitter, clock error, sample-age bound, execution platform and interrupt/bus interference before analysis.
Deadline is measured from scheduled release to command acceptance at the I/O boundary, not merely process return; include communication delay.
Missed releases and expired outputs require independently assessed monitoring; do not queue unbounded catch-up reactions.

facets.meaning: Modes and reset semantics remain domain vocabulary; this sidecar proposes obligations, not executable transition logic.
obligations: Define transition priority and handling of simultaneous reset/fault inputs in the specialized model.
Assess safe outputs and monitor independence against domain hazards; neither naming a mode nor parsing this file proves safety.

realization.strategy: A cyclic IEC 61131-3 task may realize ReactToScan. A distributed IEC 61499 network is an alternative realization only after event/data and scheduling semantics are specified; it is not equivalent merely because arrows match.
realization.placement: PLC task periods, remote I/O bus budgets, sealer controller assignment and safety-controller separation are L2 deployment analysis inputs.
limitations: No executable control law, hardware binding or analyzer result is included.
Single logical owner does not provide physical redundancy, mutual exclusion or exactly-once actuation.
Policy and clinical/operator authorization are implementation prerequisites, not asserted by these policy-free interface sketches.

artifacts.claim: Interface and explanatory pseudocode only; no control analyzer, code generator or hardware test executed.
Analysis inputs and mapping questions only; not an executable AADL model or schedulability result.

sources.title: IEC 61131-3:2013 official catalogue abstract
sources.supports: Fetched 2026-09-23. Defines syntax/semantics of PLC languages including Structured Text and Function Block Diagram. This is the 2013 edition reference, not a claim to have reviewed the latest full standard; normative text was not accessed.

sources.title: IEC 61499-1:2012 official catalogue abstract
sources.supports: Fetched 2026-09-23. Defines generic function-block architecture for distributed industrial measurement/control, with implementable reference models. Catalogue abstract only; detailed event/data execution rules require the normative standard and selected runtime.

sources.title: SEI: Architecture Analysis and Design Language (AADL)
sources.supports: Fetched 2026-09-23. Architectural component categories include processors, devices and threads; analysis of embedded-system quality attributes is distinct from a typed responsibility graph.

sources.title: AUTOSAR Classic Platform
sources.supports: Fetched with curl 2026-09-23. Distinguishes application, runtime environment and basic software; mostly hardware-independent application components communicate through RTE. Used as a separation analogy, not an avionics/medical compliance requirement.

sources.title: MathWorks: Stateflow overview
sources.supports: Official documentation URL; retrieval returned HTTP403 on 2026-09-23. State-machine modeling is relevant prior art; exact transition-order semantics must be checked in tool/version-specific documentation before implementation.
